en.headline: Cha Kwo Ling bing sutt to close on Monday
en.dek: Wing Wah Bing Sutt, open in the village since 1962, is due to shut on 5 October as Cha Kwo Ling is cleared for redevelopment.
body: Wing Wah Bing Sutt in Cha Kwo Ling Village, Yau Tong, is due to close on Monday, 5 October, as the village is cleared for redevelopment, Ming Pao reported on Saturday.
The shop opened in 1962. On Saturday, customers queued for a last meal of ham-and-egg noodles, French toast and milk tea or coffee, the paper said.

A customer from Wong Tai Sin told Ming Pao he had learned of the closing on Instagram and had come to see the old bing sutt, and that he was sorry the village was being cleared. The paper did not report a reopening plan.

zh.headline: 茶果嶺榮華冰室周一結業
zh.dek: 油塘茶果嶺村1962年開業的榮華冰室定於10月5日結業，周六已有食客排隊告別，村屋清拆重建在即。
body: 明報周六報道，油塘茶果嶺村的榮華冰室將於10月5日結業。冰室1962年開業，隨着村落清拆重建而結束營業。
報道指，周六已有市民排隊，點餐蛋麵、西多士，以及奶茶或咖啡，趁結業前再來一次。
一名家住黃大仙的食客告訴明報，他在Instagram得知冰室即將結業，特意前來看看這間舊冰室，並對茶果嶺村要清拆感到可惜。報道沒有提及搬遷或重開安排。
